args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. On-call should monitor health and error rate recovery, and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting redeploy.
